mapper.select: SELECT id, title, description, cover_image AS coverImage, created_at AS createdAt FROM album ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT id, title, description, cover_image AS coverImage, created_at AS createdAt FROM album WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO album (id, title, description, cover_image, created_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{title}, #{description}, #{coverImage}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE album SET title = #{title}, description = #{description}, cover_image = #{coverImage} WHERE id = #{id}
